Calibration rules

Both options at the selected strike and expiry are held out. Use the out-of-the-money side within ±8% log-moneyness of the forward, spread ≤20% of mid, positive bid/ask sizes, open interest ≥100 and volume ≥1. Quote age ≤120 seconds relative to the snapshot.

Require at least 3 distinct strikes per expiry and 2 supported expiries. Extreme IV outliers are rejected. No extrapolation beyond the final fitted expiry.
